question: Can an intermediate output-KL weight keep Method A's independent truth-probe performance while retaining part of Method B's behavioural (output-KL / CE) gain? GPT-2 Small layer 6, TopK L0=128.
protocol: E2E-inspired Method B protocol (script 17 train_one, unchanged) with alpha scaled by w; init from the original uninterrupted TopK checkpoint per seed; identical data order for all w; 500 steps, Adam lr 1e-5
coefficient_semantics: Method B loss = L_A + alpha*0.5*(KL_OWT+KL_GoT); alpha is the only KL coefficient (raw multiplier = the train-only scale-matched value). Fractions scale alpha; per-term weight = 0.5*alpha.
fractions_fixed: not changed after seeing any validation result
repro_check: w=1.0 seed 42 retrained with this script must reproduce the Method B seed-42 checkpoint: bit-identical, or max|param diff| <= 0.0001 (GPU non-determinism) -> pass with note; otherwise STOP. Excluded from results.
evaluation: validation only, scripts/shared/layer6_faithfulness_eval.py (independent GoT B-group probes fitted on original activations; never the teacher; no fine-tuning teacher exists in this experiment); no test rows

primary_outcomes.truth: GoT geographic independent B-MLP AUROC gap (lower better)
behaviour: OWT validation spliced CE increase (lower better)
primary_outcomes.sparsity: TopK L0 = 128 on OWT, GoT and RepE (must hold exactly)

secondary_outcomes: RepE logistic/mass-mean gaps, direction cosine, persona-shift cosine
OWT MSE, EV, cosine, dead fraction

criteria.unit: per w in {0.25, 0.50}, paired by seed; n = 3 seeds -> descriptive rules, no significance claims
criteria.consistent: better than the reference on all 3 seeds AND mean paired difference > 2 x sd of the paired differences
criteria.BEHAV: OWT output KL AND OWT spliced CE increase both consistently lower than Method A (w=0)
criteria.TRUTH_NONINFERIOR: mean paired (geo MLP gap(w) - gap(A)) <= +0.02 (margin = the guard margin used before)
criteria.TRADE: on every seed, (KL_w, gap_w) lies strictly below the seed's A-B chord: gap_w < gap_A + (gap_B - gap_A) * (KL_A - KL_w) / (KL_A - KL_B), using OWT output KL
guards: TopK L0 == 128 on OWT, GoT, RepE validation
GoT geographic B-logistic gap <= Method A + 0.02 (mean)
criteria.verdict: IMPROVES TRADE-OFF only if BEHAV AND TRUTH_NONINFERIOR AND TRADE AND all guards. If the endpoints do not differ in truth (mean gap_B - gap_A <= 0.02, i.e. no measurable trade-off), TRADE is uninformative and the trade-off conclusion is INCONCLUSIVE regardless of TRADE. One metric improving while another worsens is not success.
criteria.also_reported: fraction of Method B's KL and CE gain retained = (A - w)/(A - B), per seed and mean
